    "summary": "The investigation has identified several conditions that may have contributed to the instrument-air interruption during maintenance preparation. These include potential unrecorded service-routing changes or undocumented valve states (n-1ado6d5), communication breakdowns between Utilities and RHOB (n-1e5ou0), and various other factors such as lack of line opening authorization, normal band operator entry, utilities air gallery serving RHOB process area, area directory not establishing valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, point register mapping AL-44 to receiving-header pressure P-R but not proving every supply disturbance appears in the sample export, and work package cover indicating temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time. The investigation has also identified gaps such as no evidence confirming whether crew saw recent changes or used a different version of the equipment-location sheet (n-1gqu80), shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify point of interruption or valve states (n-1imw4n6), maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time (n-14civod), work scope being planned maintenance and inspection of 1SC dryer group D-101; receiving operation RHOB instrument-air service (n-mh84z4), work folder retained for review after interruption but maintenance deferred (n-u13nnj), local controls showing supply complaints at RHOB with request for Utilities attendance (n-b27yce), no line opening authorized at 10:02 (n-1ll2v21), 'Normal band' being operator's entry not a captured numeric measurement (n-1g2cait), utilities air gallery serving RHOB process area and local indication P-R normally showing normal pressure band (n-1xhygz5), the area directory being a location index that does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time (n-18cy7rb), point register mapping AL-44 to receiving-header pressure P-R but not proving every supply disturbance appears in sample export (n-14tzgyz), and work package cover indicating temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time (n-uk8heo).
